title: Loyalty Goodwill Terms: Member Tenure on Cleaning and Damage Fees Cleaning Charges
content:
**Rule.** The member-tenure goodwill percentage of a Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning fee approved at review is read from the whole calendar months the rider's active Wayfare Pass membership has run from its enrolled date to the approval date: the long-tenure months or more take the long-tenure percentage; from the mid-tenure months up to one month less than the long-tenure months take the mid-tenure percentage; fewer months, or no active membership, take no member-tenure goodwill.

| Whole calendar months of the active membership | Member-tenure goodwill |
|---|---|
| 12 or more (long tenure) | 8% |
| 3 to 11 (mid tenure) | 4% |
| fewer than 3 | none |
| no active membership | none |

The enrolled date and the status are those on the rider's membership record in Wayfare Pass (rider membership). The percentage reduces the fee as it stands immediately before the final rounding, after the fee has been held to its ceiling; the result is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Counting whole months (hypothetical dates)

A whole calendar month is complete on the same day of the month as the enrolled date.

| Enrolled date | Approval date | Whole months | Goodwill |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2025 | 14 March 2026 | 11 | 4% |
| 15 March 2025 | 15 March 2026 | 12 | 8% |
| 20 July 2026 | 19 October 2026 | 2 | none |
| 20 July 2026 | 20 October 2026 | 3 | 4% |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A fee standing at $90.00 immediately before the final rounding, for a rider with 4% member-tenure goodwill: $90.00 reduced by 4%, that is $86.40.
